review.finding: Superseded resume token survives a red run that fails to persist (save_state False, snapshot None, or exception): the next F0 plans against a state two invocations old.
review.suggestion: Spend the old token whenever a non-green run cannot publish a new one.

review.finding: The run_suite._one narrow-to-full fallback (slot release, full-width re-acquire, weight=0 guard under SuiteCancelled) has no run_suite-level test.
review.suggestion: Add a run_suite-level test with a Budget spy.

review.finding: gate_refused_resume fires on any exit 4 and the recorded reason blames the restored data.
A gate-refused run and its fallback both call emit_race_followups under one run_id; a duplicate triage card is possible.
review.suggestion: Pass filed race ids into the fallback pass.

review.finding: Non-.py test data under the test target is not fingerprinted.
review.suggestion: Hash every file under the target.

review.finding: The real-pytest test does not prove that restored coverage of an untouched file survives --cov-append of a re-run unit.
review.suggestion: Give beta an unedited second lib.

review.finding: run_suite(resume=..., resume_fallback=...) encodes one fact twice.
_run_dir keeps a leading underscore though used.
